scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm exec -w @moneyflow/api tsx watch src/index.ts" "npm exec -w @moneyflow/web vite"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @moneyflow/shared && npm run build -w @moneyflow/web && npm run build -w @moneyflow/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @moneyflow/shared && npm run build -w @moneyflow/api && npm exec -w @moneyflow/web tsc -b
scripts.test: npm run test -w @moneyflow/api && npm run test -w @moneyflow/web
